143: {phang}{opt nofastcollapse}: Turns off the default cell collapse, which speeds up {it:wooldid} considerably by evaluating the {it:margins} calls on one row per cohort-by-period-by-treatment cell rather than on every observation. The regression itself still runs on the full data. Results agree with an uncollapsed run to {it:margins}' own accuracy, typically machine precision, but up to about 1e-6 relative on standard errors with sampling weights, controls and an event-study window, where neither run is exact. The collapse applies to binary and continuous treatments, to poisson, to subgroups and inside {it:bootstrap()} and {it:permute()} replications. It is skipped, with a caution naming the option responsible, under {it:interactivecontrols()}, {it:contreatpoly()} above 1, the {it:contreat()} variable also appearing inside {it:controls()}, {it:coarsecohortcontrols()}, {it:fe()} or {it:ccc_absorb()}, and {it:unconditionalse}. Disable it yourself when controls or fixed effects interact with treatment in a way {it:wooldid} cannot detect, such as a control built from a renamed copy of the treatment variable, since the collapse assumes the treatment effect is constant within a cell. Disable it also when memory is tight, since the collapse holds an extra copy of the data, and when you need byte-for-byte reproduction of an uncollapsed result. {p_end}
164: {phang}{opt boot:strap(mode)}: Bootstrap inference. Every reported standard error, test statistic, p-value and confidence interval becomes a bootstrap quantity, including the joint tests, subgroup contrasts, plots, {it:gteffects} cells and {it:pretrendpower()}. Point estimates are unchanged, and the analytic covariance is kept in the hidden {it:e(V_analytic)}. Each replication re-estimates the full model. {it:bootstrap(standard)} is the pairs cluster bootstrap, resampling the {it:cluster()} groups, or the observations without {it:cluster()}. {it:bootstrap(bayes)} is the Bayesian bootstrap. It multiplies each cluster's observations by a Dirichlet weight, so no cluster ever leaves the sample. Requires {it:reps()}. Refused with {it:permute()}, {it:impvalues}, {it:unconditionalse}, {it:customvce()} and multi-way {it:cluster()}. {it:fastnose} is accepted with a caution and has no effect, except with {it:boottstat}, where it is refused. {it:bootstrap(bayes)} is refused with {it:att_it}, {it:att_i} and {it:att_itime}, since it omits the cell-sampling component of their variance. {it:wooldid} cautions when fewer than 6 clusters are treated. Neither mode is a remedy for few treated clusters, and no wild cluster bootstrap is offered. Use {it:permute()} there, or {help boottest} on the underlying regression outside {it:wooldid}. When {it:cluster()} does not nest {it:i}, some unit spans two clusters and a cell-weighted estimand is requested, a caution says its standard errors may be understated. The remedies are a finer {it:i} or a {it:cluster()} that nests {it:i}. When {it:cluster()} nests {it:i} and the run carries {it:att_it}, {it:att_i}, {it:att_itime} or {it:boottstat}, each drawn copy of a cluster gets fresh unit codes, also where {it:i} is named in {it:fe()}, {it:controls()}, {it:interactivecontrols()}, {it:coarsecohortcontrols()} or {it:ccc_absorb()}. A variable that encodes {it:i} under another name, or was merged in on {it:i}, keeps its original codes. {p_end}
432: {synopt:{it:e(summarystats)}} Summary statistics on the outcome and any continuous treatment, under {it:summarystats}. The columns are {it:mean}, {it:median}, {it:sd}, {it:iqr}, {it:p25}, {it:p75}, {it:min} and {it:max}. The rows are {it:y_insample}, {it:y_pretreat}, {it:y_posttreat} and {it:y_control}, and under {it:contreat()} {it:c_insample}, {it:c_pretreat}, {it:c_posttreat} and {it:c_control}. Some are also returned as scalars: {it:e(ypre_mean)}, {it:e(ypre_med)}, {it:e(ypre_sd)} and {it:e(ypre_iqr)}, and under {it:contreat()} {it:e(contreat_mean)}, {it:e(contreat_med)} and {it:e(contreat_sd)} with {it:contreatpre_} and {it:contreatpost_} versions of the same three. Under {it:contreatcontrols(untreatedZero)} the {it:c_pretreat} and {it:c_control} rows and the {it:contreatpre_} scalars are not returned. Under {it:contreatwithin} neither control row is. {p_end}
